utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the sixteenth. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, you're there. Before we start, whose new car is that in the car park? Takes up most of the view from the window.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one held together with road salt.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Thought we'd had a visiting director. Very shiny for this place.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, vehicle inspection over. Everyone on?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Just heard someone mention the charity bake sale on Friday. Apparently my flapjack's still being discussed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The charity bake sale on Friday, yeah. That flapjack needed a permit to break into.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: It was structurally sound. I'll give it that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Unlike this conversation. Right, closed work first, then what's actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the IM1 hydraulic unit on Tuesday. That's last Tuesday, obviously. All closed, not another inspection for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, that was the old entry I was looking at.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I tested the boiler safety valve yesterday and it's all fine now. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Finished the repair on the water booster last night. That's complete from my side.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Ah, good. That was the one still showing on the old handover, wasn't it?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, old information. Not asking for another repair.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: While we're on nights, noticed the CT1 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Settled back to normal, you mean?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, normal again. Just an observation, not raising a job off it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Same sort of thing, I heard a slight rattle from the fire panel, nothing to action yet. Just saying what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. No fault job being raised for that noise.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Separately, we do still need someone to run a function test on the fire panel. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to take the function test? It's separate from the rattle, to be clear.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. Haven't got room to take that on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, no takers. The fire panel function test stays unallocated, no rush. Nobody against it as owner.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper tomorrow. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Is that the jam itself, or are you thinking the sensor's what's keeping it stopped?

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Could be either at the minute. That's why I'm taking both together, rather than calling the sensor faulty before I've cleared it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Davey. Clear the jam and check the sensors on the wrapper tomorrow, fairly important. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the boiler feed pump tomorrow at 9:30. No rush on that one.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You've got the pressure history already, haven't you?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, I've got the existing trend in front of me. Enough to start the investigation; I'm not claiming we've found a cause yet.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Fiona, boiler feed pump pressure drop investigation tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: That's right. No rush, just keeping that time for it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And I'll grease and check the bearings on the GT2. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, that one. I'll take it myself.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: GT2, yeah. I thought you were going to say it was an urgent bearing job for a second.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, no—grease and check. Not calling it a bearing failure.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got it. Sarah Okafor on the GT2 bearings, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you chase the purchase order for the line 2 guard by Thursday? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, I can't take that one. I haven't got the capacity to own the purchase order chase.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Dave, can you take that instead—chase the purchase order for the line 2 guard by Thursday? Same priority: not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it instead. I'll chase the purchase order for the line 2 guard by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks. Definitely with you rather than me, then.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yep. My glamorous procurement career continues.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I'll send the shift handover report round by Thursday as well. Normal priority for that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's the report, rather than another handover meeting?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just the report going round, yeah. No extra meeting hiding in there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Fiona has the shift handover report, by Thursday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Um, I'll take vibration readings on the turbine one compressor tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out. Which compressor?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: The turbine one compressor. I'll take the vibration readings tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Heard it that time. Olumide Adeyemi, vibration readings on the turbine one compressor tomorrow morning. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, that's me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And my blocker hasn't changed: can't get to the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Still blocked, not a fresh commitment for today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Still waiting on parts for the air dryer too. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: So that's still the parts hold, not something that's ready to go?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Still blocked. No work to allocate on that while we're waiting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And we were going to replace the belt on the Air Compressor 1, but that's been pushed to next month, so ignore it. It's off this list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that belt replacement isn't part of today's agreed work.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the water booster is closed, just so the old handover doesn't make it look like another live one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. We've kept the completed bits separate. Only thing raised without an owner is the fire panel function test, and that stays no rush.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: I'm clear on my two. The wrapper tomorrow, purchase order for the line 2 guard by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Same here. Boiler feed pump tomorrow at 9:30, report round by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: All clear. Teams only swallowed the useful bit of my update, as usual.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Could hear every word about my flapjack, though. Funny that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Perfect audio for the important issues. Right, thanks everyone. That's us.
